expects.query: Plan only; do not run commands, start containers, call AMC/VIOS, download data, or modify files. Deploy rtvi-cv-3d on /data/videos/cam_*.mp4 with MODELS_DIR=/data/vss-app-data/models and BEV_DATASET_PATH=/data/mv3dt/bev-dataset, but calibration is missing. Return the high-level ordered plan: preserve the standalone inputs, delegate calibration to vss-generate-video-calibration, follow its current downstream-output contract, then validate the returned artifacts and resume standalone RTVI-CV-3D deployment.
checks: The plan identifies missing calibration before deployment and hands local MP4 calibration to vss-generate-video-calibration instead of inventing calibration files.

The standalone plan delegates AMC setup, prerequisites, detector choice, input handling, calibration, VIOS needs, and result handling to the current vss-generate-video-calibration instructions instead of reproducing them.

After the calibration skill completes, the plan follows its current downstream-output contract and validates calibration JSON by filtering sensors to type == camera with at least two non-empty safe unique camera IDs.
The plan stages BEV map/transforms assets and uses standalone RTVI-CV-3D config generation/compose, not warehouse calibration mount paths.
The agent does not actually deploy containers, invoke AMC/VIOS APIs, register RTSP streams, or require the placeholder /data resources to exist.
